PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -c "
import inspect, api
out = '# Inventory API\n\nEvery function returns a plain dictionary or list and raises \`ValueError\` for invalid input.\n'
for name, obj in vars(api).items():
    if inspect.isfunction(obj) and not name.startswith('_'):
        out += '\n### ' + name + str(inspect.signature(obj)) + '\n\n' + inspect.getdoc(obj).splitlines()[0] + '\n'
open('docs/API.md', 'w').write(out)
"
